notes: The ASV reverses the order of the two objects of ἀπόδοτε in each clause; rule 15 permits the reordering and rule 2 keeps the pairs split.

τὰ Καίσαρος / τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ: the article takes *the things* under rule 22 and the genitive carries the recast relativizer and copula under rule 92, the genitive being an expressed token able to carry them.
